response: AIRING OUT A BOATHOUSE IS IMPORTANT FOR KEEPING THE NEIGHBORHOOD CLEAN AND HEALTHY. WE NEED TO MAKE SURE THE BOATHOUSE IS VACATED BEFORE THE WIND STIRS. WE SHOULD REMOVE ALL ITEMS FROM THE BOATHOUSE TO PREVENT THE GROWTH OF MOLD AND FUNGUS. WE NEED TO CLEAN THE EXTERIOR OF THE BOATHOUSE WITH A DRY WIPER. WE SHOULD WASH THE ROOF AND SKYLIGHT TO REMOVE DEBRIS. WE NEED TO CHECK FOR ANY DAMAGE TO THE BOATHOUSE STRUCTURE. WE SHOULD REMOVE ANY FISH OR FOOD ITEMS FROM THE BOATHOUSE. WE NEED TO MAKE SURE THE BOATHOUSE IS EMPTY AND CLEAN BEFORE THE NEXT USE. WE SHOULD NOTIFY THE NEIGHBORHOOD OF THE AIRDING PROCESS TO PREVENT ANY CONFLICTS.
